verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://react.dev/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured React Documentation index. Many docs pages are also served as raw markdown (.md URLs such as learn.md and reference/react-dom/client/createRoot.md), so an agent can ingest agent-friendly docs directly. Missing for 10: first-party documentation that explains or promotes llms.txt and markdown docs for agent use, and independent reports of agents successfully using them.
